memory.fill was decoded with two immediate bytes instead of one, which desynchronised uor_wasm_score_token_salience_default_key (131 instructions reported; 129 decoded).
0xFD (SIMD) and other 0xFC-prefixed instructions were skipped, not reported; the 0xFC 0..7 saturating float truncations were not counted as float.
SIMD immediates were mis-sized: splats skipped 16 bytes and lane operations read a memory argument.
The recorded commit was the checked-out HEAD, not the build commit.
Export indices were used as code-section indices; that is wrong for a module with imported functions (this module has none).
